title: 第16章 苦命打工道兵潇洒地仙老板第17章 赤鸦混吃军方地仙道修士到来
content_zh:
在家里安全休息一晚，精神状态恢复饱满。
第二天清晨，陆羽继续回到蛇信村部族，在箭塔上采炼大日紫气。
天还未亮，清晨的林地里还有一层稀薄的雾气。
在道土里关了一晚上的赤鸦道兵，欢悦地振翅乱飞，适应着成为道兵后增强的肉体与力量。
初时，赤鸦道兵还很不适应，在扑腾了一阵子后，就已经可以在蛇信村堡垒附近随意乱飞。
时不时还从空中飞扑而下，在丛林中寻找，抓到一二蛇鼠当做早餐零食。
将赤睛妖乌炼成赤鸦道兵，并不意味着结束。
赤鸦道兵光有采炼的天地灵气可不够，日常依旧需要喂食，补充营养。
道兵，道兵，这就跟古代将军养的亲兵一样，也是需要投入资源培养。
昨夜，陆羽就给赤鸦道兵喂了十分之一支的生命21号，充足的营养补充，才让赤鸦道兵今天活蹦乱跳的。
要是在赤鸦道兵融合赤鸦道种后，进化提升快速发育的时间里不喂食，赤鸦道兵在道土里待上一夜估计就能饿出问题来。
“炼出了道兵，只是开始，往后还需要耗费资源培养，地仙道的修炼，终究是离不开资源。穷啊！”
往后，随着赤鸦炼日诀的进步，他还能炼制更多的道兵，陆羽想想都知道往后的压力。
在自身道土没有扩大，发展到一定规模之前，资源是地仙道修士永远避不开的话题。
道侣法财，缺一不可。
陆羽隐隐有些明白，何为地仙之道了。
.......
当天边微亮，太阳即将升起的时候，赤鸦道兵也在陆羽的召唤中，回到他的身边。
一夜过去，赤鸦道兵成长了不少，已从刚开始的母鸡大小，成长到了公鸡大小。
漆黑羽毛，红赤火眼，神骏非凡，羽翼开合间，隐有淡淡的真火气息流转，热风萦身。

陆羽望着眼前这只初具凶威的道兵，眼中闪过一丝满意。
短短一夜，便已脱胎换骨。
等到天际微白，太阳初升，陆羽照例遥望天际大日，采炼大日紫气。
体验着被异界大日紫气灌注的快乐，他身旁的赤鸦道兵也如陆羽一般，体内赤鸦道种滴溜溜地运转采炼大日紫气。
虽然赤鸦道兵采炼的大日紫气数量才不到陆羽的十分之一，但除去赤鸦道兵存在体内，炼化吸收的一部分外，竟然还有一半富余，能吐入道土中，供养陆羽。
“有了赤鸦道兵，便相当于找了个给我打工的员工，管着道兵的饭，就能给我赚来更多的资源！”
看着道土内赤鸦道兵采炼的大日紫气，陆羽嘴角微翘，稍微一算，就知道他是赚到了。
这点大日紫气，相当于陆羽刚入门赤鸦炼日诀，没练成道文，赤鸦道种时，在帝国那边三日采炼的大日紫气。
相当于地仙管理局内网商城中110标准单位的大日紫气。
一标准单位的大日紫气价值十多功勋，供不应求。
110标准单位的大日紫气，相当于一点多功勋。
换算成帝国龙币，最少相当于一百多万。
光买生命21号，都能买上一盒多。
与这一比，赤鸦道兵吃的那点生命21号可就显得微不足道了。
当然，这是陆羽可以穿梭两界，能在异界这边采炼到更多的大日紫气之后才有的收益。
若是仅在帝国那边，收益可能会降低不少，但养炼道兵也绝对不会是亏本的事。
赤鸦道兵练成后，不光可以采炼早晨的大日紫气，还可以在白天的时候采炼大日火气。
这又是一笔丰厚的收益。
不用发工资，仅仅只需要保证伙食，当道兵的老板肯定不会亏。
光是自己打工，地仙道修士怎么负担得起日益增多的修炼消耗，又怎能养得起一片属于自己的道土。

只有培养出更多为自己打工的道兵，物尽其用，才能在地仙大道上勇攀高峰，越走越远。
等到太阳升起。
赤鸦道兵沐浴在清晨的阳光下，黑色的羽毛镀上了一层金色的阳光。
陆羽细细感应，一缕缕清晨太阳的大日火气在赤鸦道种的运转中流入赤鸦道兵的体内。
呼吸吐纳间，这些大日火气混杂着赤鸦道兵的精气神就被道种炼化，熔炼成赤鸦道兵体内的法力。
content_en:
After a safe night's rest at home, your mental state will be restored.
In the early morning of the next day, Lu Yu continued to return to the tribe in Shexin Village and collected the Purple Energy of the Sun on the Arrow Tower.
It was still dark, and there was still a thin layer of fog in the early morning forest.
The red crow Taoist soldier who had been locked up in the Taoist soil for a night fluttered his wings happily, adapting to the enhanced body and strength after becoming a Taoist soldier.
At first, the Red Crow Taoist soldiers were not used to it. After fluttering for a while, they were able to fly around at will near the fortress of Shexin Village.
From time to time, he would swoop down from the air, search in the jungle, and catch one or two snakes and rats for breakfast snacks.
Refining the Red Eye Demon Crow into the Red Crow Taoist Soldier does not mean the end.
It is not enough for the red crow Taoist soldiers to collect the spiritual energy of heaven and earth. They still need to feed and supplement their nutrition on a daily basis.
Dao soldiers, Dao soldiers, are just like the personal soldiers raised by ancient generals. They also need to invest resources in training.
Last night, Lu Yu fed Red Crow Taoist Soldier one-tenth of a bottle of Life No. 21. With sufficient nutritional supplements, Red Crow Taoist Soldier was alive and kicking today.
If the Red Crow Taoist soldiers were not fed during the period of rapid development and evolution after they merged with the Red Crow Taoist species, the Red Crow Taoist soldiers would probably starve into trouble if they stayed in the Tao soil for one night.
"Refining Tao soldiers is just the beginning. Resources will need to be expended to cultivate them in the future. The cultivation of Earth Immortal Tao is ultimately inseparable from resources. How poor!"
In the future, as Red Crow Sun Refining Technique progresses, he will be able to refine more Taoist weapons. Lu Yu knows the pressure in the future just thinking about it.
Before their own Tao soil has expanded and developed to a certain scale, resources are a topic that Earth Immortal Tao monks can never avoid.
A Taoist couple's Dharma and wealth are indispensable.
Lu Yu vaguely understood what the way of the Earth Immortal was.
.......
When the sky was slightly bright and the sun was about to rise, the red crow Taoist soldiers also returned to Lu Yu's summons.
As the night passed, Red Crow Taoist Soldier grew up a lot, from the size of a hen at the beginning to the size of a rooster.
It has jet black feathers, red fire eyes, and an extraordinary horse. Between the opening and closing of the wings, there is a faint breath of real fire flowing, and the hot wind lingers around the body.
Lu Yu looked at the Taoist soldier who was beginning to gain menacing power with a trace of satisfaction flashing in his eyes.
In just one night, he was completely transformed.
When the sky turned white and the sun began to rise, Lu Yu looked at the sun in the sky as usual, gathering the purple energy of the sun.
Experiencing the joy of being infused with the purple energy of the great sun from another world, the Red Crow Taoist soldier beside him was like Lu Yu, with the red crow Taoist seeds inside his body running smoothly to extract the purple energy of the great sun.
Although the amount of the Great Sun Purple Qi collected by the Red Crow Taoist soldiers was less than one-tenth of Lu Yu's, apart from the part that the Red Crow Taoist soldiers had stored in their bodies and refined and absorbed, there was actually half left over, which could be spit into the Tao soil to support Lu Yu.
"Having the Red Crow Taoist Soldier is equivalent to finding an employee to work for me. He can take care of the Taoist Soldier's meals and earn me more resources!"
Looking at the Purple Sun Qi collected by the red crow Taoist soldiers in Dao Tu, the corners of Lu Yu's mouth slightly curled up. After a little calculation, he knew that he had made a profit.
This bit of the Great Sun Purple Qi is equivalent to the Great Sun Purple Qi that Lu Yu spent three days in the empire to refine when he just started practicing the Red Crow Sun Refining Technique and has not yet mastered the Tao Wen.
It is equivalent to 110 standard units of the Great Sun Purple Energy in the Dixian Administration Intranet Mall.
One standard unit of Great Sun Purple Qi is worth more than ten meritorious deeds, and demand exceeds supply.
110 standard units of the Great Sun Purple Qi is equivalent to a little more meritorious service.
Converted into Imperial Dragon Coins, it is equivalent to at least over one million.
If you just buy Life 21, you can buy more than one box.
Compared with this, the little bit of life No. 21 the Red Crow Taoist had eaten seemed insignificant.
Of course, this is the benefit that Lu Yu can only get after he can travel between the two worlds and collect more purple energy of the sun in the other world.
If it were only on the empire's side, the income might be reduced a lot, but raising and refining Taoist soldiers would definitely not be a loss-making thing.
After the Red Crow Taoist is trained, not only can he harvest the great sun in the morning,Purple Qi can also be collected during the day to refine the Sun Fire Qi.
This is another huge profit.
There is no need to pay wages, only food is guaranteed, and the boss of the Taoist soldier will definitely not lose money.
Just by working on their own, how can Earth Immortal Dao monks afford the increasing consumption of cultivation, and how can they afford to raise a piece of Dao soil of their own?
Only by cultivating more Tao soldiers who work for themselves and making full use of them can we bravely climb the peak and go further and further on the Earthly Immortal Road.
Wait until the sun rises.
The red crow Taoist soldier was bathed in the morning sun, and his black feathers were coated with a layer of golden sunlight.
Lu Yu felt carefully that wisps of the great sun's fire energy from the early morning sun flowed into the Red Crow Taoist soldiers' bodies during the movement of the Red Crow Taoist species.
As he breathed in and out, the fire energy of the sun mixed with the essence of the Red Crow Taoist soldiers was refined by the Tao seeds, and was smelted into the mana within the Red Crow Taoist soldiers.
